concerns.text: The three HuggingFace PR datasets cited (nebius/SWE-rebench-V2-PRs, prs-eth/AGBD, prs-eth/AGBD-Lite) are described as containing PR metadata, but they do not reliably provide the `first_comment_at` timestamp required to compute the primary outcome `review_effort_duration`. Without this field the core hypothesis cannot be evaluated, making the chosen datasets inappropriate for the research question.

Generating CodeBERT embeddings on a CPU‑only GitHub Actions runner (2 vCPU, ≈7 GB RAM) is likely to exceed the memory and time budget, as the CodeBERT model (~400 M parameters) typically requires >2 GB RAM and several seconds per inference. This threatens the 6 h wall‑time limit, especially when processing thousands of snippets, and thus the compute plan is infeasible under the free‑compute constraints.
